label: Inborn Errors of Metabolism Metabolic Pathways
description: Retrieves pathways classified under metabolic pathway ontology terms, filtering by label to find metabolic pathway annotations.
query:
PREFIX owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX wp: <http://vocabularies.wikipathways.org/wp#>

SELECT distinct ?pathway ?label ?tag
WHERE {
  ?tag1 a owl:Class ;
  rdfs:label ?label .
  ?tag rdfs:subClassOf* ?tag1.
  ?pathway a wp:Pathway; wp:ontologyTag ?tag.
FILTER regex(str(?label), "metabolic pathway")
}
